name: design-language-foundation
title: Design-Language Standard + Component Library + Generation Guardrails
description:
Establish a project-wide design canon with operator-curated defaults, bind it to mockup generation as the style anchor for new scenarios, build the React rendering substrate that consumes the canon (folding in the existing react-component-library scenario), and enforce conformance at agent generation time — not after-the-fact.

Operator declared this the top priority of three infrastructure initiatives surfaced on the 2026-04-25 vision walk (others: BAS-readiness, hosted-Vrooli-deployment-research). Design canon is currently absent project-wide; scenarios drift visually with no shared language. Same failure mode pattern as voice canon (existed at docs/marketing/STRATEGY.md but was not enforced; agents drifted; operator was unaware canon existed).

New-scenario mockup generation has no style anchor today. The existing ai-image-generation-foundation initiative covers BAS-grounded mockups for existing scenarios but assumes new scenarios will have AI-invent-from-scratch — that produces drift across scenarios. Design canon as input to ui-mockup-generation is the missing link; this initiative provides it.

Known gaps to workshop (not items yet):
- Research Google open-source design.md standard; evaluate fit for Vrooli (versioning, diff-friendliness, layered overrides per scenario)
- Define 2-3 default canon files at canonical project path (likely under docs/design/ or scenarios/scenario-launcher/templates/) — base, dark/light variants, density variants
- Wire chosen canon into ui-mockup-generation skill (closes the new-scenario mockup gap). This adds a depends_on edge from execute/ui-mockup-generation-skill (in ai-image-generation-foundation initiative) to this initiative Phase 1 output.
- Knowledge-observatory enforces canonical per-scenario design.md location
- React-component-library scenario (currently exists at v0.0.1 with no driving initiative) becomes the implementation arm — primitives that conform to and render the canon
- Generation-time linter (design-linter) that gates agent UI output against the canon. Same enforcement-substrate pattern as idea/marketing-voice-linter (filed 2026-04-25). Together these constitute an agent-generation-guardrails capability bigger than any individual canon — voice + design + code-style + a11y + branding all use the same gate.
- Scenario-launcher integration: when a new scenario is created, operator picks a canon variant; chosen canon lands at the canonical path in the new scenario directory.
- Cross-cutting tie-in to brand-manager scenario for visual identity (colors, typography) — eventually brand-manager owns structured storage for these and the design-canon inherits.

Items to pull in: the existing react-component-library scenario development becomes part of this initiative implementation phase. Per option B from the 2026-04-25 walk: design-language defines the canon, react-component-library renders it; one initiative, two artifacts.

Items to NOT pull in: the existing image-generation initiatives (ai-image-generation-foundation, decision-question-visuals, decision-visual-grounding-propagation) stay where they are. The design canon Phase 1 output becomes a new dependency on their ui-mockup-generation-skill item; that is the only cross-edge.

See orchestration-summary.md for sequencing, decisions, and pattern notes.
